0022600039.text: The Utah Jazz (1-11, 0-5 on the road, 0-10 in their last ten, 15th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (9-3, 6-1 at home, 7-3 in their last ten, 2nd in the Southwest) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, the Jazz's 13th of the season. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), while Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Jazz lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 140-106 loss in Houston on April 3, 2026.
